title: SukunaBow
description: A powerful datapack inspired by Sukuna's Flame Bow from Jujutsu Kaisen, featuring cursed arrows and explosive fire damage.
body:
🔥 CURSED FLAME BOW: THE KING OF CURSES' ARSENAL 🔥
Have you ever dreamed of wielding the destructive power of the Fire Arrow (Fuga) used by the "King of Curses," Sukuna, from Jujutsu Kaisen?

This Datapack introduces a cursed weapon that is as lethal as it is powerful. More than just a simple bow, this is the embodiment of hellfire that strikes fear into the heart of any entity!

🛠 THE RITUAL (CRAFTING)
To claim this cursed power, a standard crafting table won't suffice. You must perform a ritual by dropping the following ingredients on the ground at the same spot:

🏹 1 Bow

🔥 64 Blaze Rods

⏳ 1 Soul Sand

🌋 1 Magma Block

Once gathered, a surge of cursed energy will erupt, granting you the Cursed Flame Bow!

⚔️ SPECIAL ABILITIES
This bow possesses two distinct firing modes based on your stance:

💥 Normal Shot: Explosive Impact
Every arrow released carries the essence of fire, triggering an instant explosion upon hitting the target. Perfect for clearing out swarms of mobs in the blink of an eye.

🧨 Ultimate Skill: TNT Rain (Sneak Skill)
By Sneaking (Shift) while firing, the arrow becomes infused with a high-level curse. Upon impact, it triggers a chain of TNT explosions, leveling everything in its path. This is the ultimate simulation of Sukuna’s destructive might!

⚠️ THE COST OF THE CURSE (WARNING)
Ultimate power always comes with a price:

Insatiable Hunger: As a cursed weapon, every shot drains your vitality, inflicting a heavy Hunger effect. Always carry food, or you might collapse before the enemy does.

Weapon Degradation: This bow is not immortal. Excessive use without monitoring its durability will cause it to shatter. Don't let your ultimate weapon vanish in the heat of battle!
